description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeePunchInOutController class within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. The class handles pre-render logic for punch in/out employee attendance records, determining whether an employee's last punch is a punch-in or punch-out, setting up Vue.js components with relevant properties based on the attendance data, and managing request parameters for employee ID and date.

classes.name: EmployeePunchInOutController
classes.description: Controller handling pre-render logic for employee punch in/out functionality, extending the abstract Vue controller and utilizing attendance services.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with appropriate properties based on whether the employee's last attendance record indicates a punch-in or punch-out, based on request parameters. Throws an exception if employeeId is missing.
